label: copy-phase q/w input when w is being or about to be output
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during original tokens or on <DEL>), almost always when the fed-back input is q (80% of mass) or w (18%). The strongest activations are q inputs whose output at this step is w (the original sequence had q w), e.g. q w w b <DEL> [q] [w]; the next w input fires more weakly when another w follows. Being in the first few copy positions (recall_idx 1-4) and short L push it up. Plain q input in the copy phase covers 78% of activations but only 8% of those steps fire, so the w context is needed. q followed by other letters (a, c, l) gives weak activations that the predicate misses. It does not fire on other tokens or on first occurrences of a token (in_first=1). Predicate dev: P 0.45, R 0.54, F1 0.49, mass recall 0.77.
